= Ai Observability
:artifactid: camel-ai-observability-starter

Spring Boot auto-configuration for Camel GenAI observability.

Add this starter to opt in to GenAI observability for Camel AI producers. It brings `camel-ai-observability`, so the AI
producers emit OpenTelemetry spans and Micrometer metrics once a tracing or metrics backend is on the classpath as
well, for example `camel-opentelemetry2-starter`. `camel-observability-services-starter` does not include it: add this
starter as well when the application uses it.

Configure it in `application.properties`:

[source,properties]
----
# Disable GenAI observability for all AI producers (default is true)
camel.aiobservability.enabled=false
# How much is recorded: basic (default), detailed or full; full records prompts and completions
camel.aiobservability.level=detailed
# Maximum length of every text recorded at level full (default 8192)
camel.aiobservability.content-max-length=4096
# Do not record a model or tool call that the AI framework already traces, such as Spring AI (default true)
camel.aiobservability.defer-to-framework=true
----

Relaxed binding also accepts `camel.aiObservability.*` and `camel.ai-observability.*`. The options are handed to the Camel `PropertiesComponent` as override properties named `camel.aiObservability.enabled`, `camel.aiObservability.level`, `camel.aiObservability.contentMaxLength` and `camel.aiObservability.deferToFramework`, matching Camel Main and JBang.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-ai-observability-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----

== Spring Boot Auto-Configuration

The starter supports 4 options, which are listed below.

[width="100%",cols="2,5,^1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Name | Description | Default | Type
| camel.aiobservability.content-max-length | The maximum length of every text (message, tool argument or result) recorded at level full. Longer texts are cut. | 8192 | Integer
| camel.aiobservability.defer-to-framework | When the AI framework behind a component already traces its model calls and tool calls (Spring AI with an ObservationRegistry, quarkus-langchain4j, a LangChain4j model with an observation listener), Camel does not record its own span and metrics for them, so that they are counted once. | true | Boolean
| camel.aiobservability.enabled | Enables GenAI observability for Camel AI producers (OpenTelemetry spans and Micrometer metrics when backends are present). | true | Boolean
| camel.aiobservability.level | How much GenAI telemetry is recorded: basic, detailed or full. basic records one span per LLM call with model, token usage and finish reason. detailed adds the structure of agent runs (an agent span with one span per LLM call and per tool call), request parameters, cached tokens and the conversation id. full adds prompts, completions and tool arguments and results, which may hold personal or confidential data. Metrics are not affected. | basic | String
|===
